name: dropbox_list_folder
description: List files and folders in a Dropbox directory. Returns names, types, sizes, and modification dates. Use when browsing folder contents or checking what's stored at a path.

path.description: Folder path — "" for the account root, otherwise e.g. "/Documents"

name: dropbox_search
description: Search Dropbox for files and folders by name or content. Returns matching paths, file types, and metadata. Use when you need to find a file without knowing its exact location.

name: dropbox_get_metadata
description: Get detailed metadata for a file or folder: size, modified date, ID, sharing status, and revision info. Use before downloading or modifying to inspect properties.

name: dropbox_download
description: Download a file from Dropbox and return its content as text plus metadata (size, type, modified date). Use to retrieve file contents for processing or inspection.

name: dropbox_create_folder
description: Create a new folder in Dropbox at a specified path. Returns folder metadata. Use to organize files or set up directory structures.

path.description: Path of the folder to create (e.g., "/New Folder")

autorename.description: Auto-rename if a folder with the same name exists (default false)
